subject: Life Skills
title: Power Outage Readiness
description: A quick win: understand Power Outage Readiness.

hook.text: Texas, 2021. A winter storm killed the grid for days. Millions had no heat, no light, and no plan for any of it.

buildup.text: Power outages can last hours or weeks. Your fridge food spoils in 4 hours. Your phone dies in a day without charging.

discovery.text: Keep a hand-crank or battery-powered radio. When the internet goes dark, radio is the last reliable broadcast channel.

twist.text: A full freezer stays cold for 48 hours if you keep the door shut. Half-full lasts 24. Fill gaps with water bottles.

climax.text: Charge a portable power bank monthly and keep it full. It gives your phone two or three extra days of battery life.

punchline.text: Full freezer, charged bank, crank radio. Outage-proof.

quiz.question: How long does a full freezer stay cold if the power goes out?
